# Specs

<!-- Generated by seed-golden-context | Last updated: 2026-05-11 -->

This directory holds implementation-level specs for active or recently shipped work in `contentful-core.php`.

Spec files follow the naming convention: `YYYY-MM-<short-description>.md`

Each spec should capture:
- **Status:** `draft` | `in-progress` | `done`
- **Problem:** What is being built and why
- **Approach:** Key technical decisions, interfaces, data shapes
- **Out of scope:** What this spec explicitly excludes
- **Open questions:** Unresolved items at time of writing

No specs are currently active. Add one here when starting significant new work.
